reason: A mobile-focused UI plugin that adapts the DeepSeek Harness web interface with responsive chat, drawer, sheet, touch, and safe-area behavior while leaving desktop layouts unchanged.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供移动端优先的响应式布局、抽屉与全屏面板、触控交互及安全区域适配。
summaries.en: Adapts the DeepSeek Harness web interface for mobile with responsive chat, drawer and full-screen sheet layouts, touch interactions, and safe-area support.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface for narrow viewports
Provides responsive sidebar drawer and full-screen sheet layouts
Adds client-side touch and keyboard interaction handling
Injects scoped CSS and registers web UI slot contributions
